purpose: Provide immediate visual context in MEDTAS without turning the Control Center into a heavy CAD renderer.

layers.use: functional interface, datum responsibility, envelope and key controlled dimensions
layers.performance: negligible; no external image file or graphics library

layers.implementation: optional PNG/WebP exported on explicit user command and stored in reports/previews
layers.performance: loaded only when available; never continuously rendered

rule: A schematic or preview is navigation context only. It never becomes design authority and cannot satisfy a CAD/drawing release gate.
current_v8_3: J2 Technical Filter includes two inline SVG schematics. Cached CAD preview export is deferred until the current K01 release path is stable.
